header:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one production-ready game UI backplate, not a mockup screenshot.
Reference image: the attached existing game ornament is a MATERIAL AND PAINTING STYLE reference only. Create a NEW compact horizontal turn/control plaque for a dark realistic Cthulhu card game, usable across forest, ruins, cosmic, and bone themes.
Single isolated horizontal plaque with actual transparent background, straight-on orthographic front view. Artwork approximately 3.3:1 width:height, centered on a wide canvas. Tarnished low-brightness old brass and dark iron rim, a few restrained weathered irregular gothic corner points, smoky charcoal leather/slate interior with subtle worn texture. No big decorative emblem. The LEFT 56% interior is a broad completely blank text area; the RIGHT 38% is a second completely blank continuous dark area intended for two real UI controls placed by code later. A small thin metal divider separates the two areas around 60% of width. Both usable interiors share a common vertical center; keep border weight restrained so this remains readable at 270px wide. Outer rim may extend slightly at the left corners; the top and right rim will meet the screen border.
NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO icons, NO circles, NO dial, NO astrology, NO stars, NO cloth banner, NO tentacles, NO scene or background. Do not draw the two controls. Do not make it cartoonish, glossy, gold-bright or overly ornate. Preserve authentic worn muted metal detailing and subdued charcoal tones of the reference. Deliver only this one clean cutout backplate, transparent outside.
log:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one production-ready blank log journal panel for a dark realistic Cthulhu card game.
Reference image: existing game UI ornament is for MATERIAL AND PAINTING STYLE only. Create a NEW vertical flat journal page inset, not a hanging banner. It is a physical old field-journal page held in a narrow dark worn leather cover with a thin muted tarnished brass reinforced spine at LEFT, worn layered paper edges at RIGHT, restrained corner caps. Single readable page, viewed orthographically front-on, NOT tilted or open double-page book. Rough rectangular silhouette with realistic little chipped/bent corners, sturdy straight page bottom, no pointed pennant end.
Portrait panel approximately width:height 0.8:1. Real transparent background outside the journal silhouette. The writing surface must be dark desaturated smoke-brown/gray vellum with soft worn paper grain, slightly lighter at worn edges, quiet across the whole interior for live pale Chinese text rendered by code. Keep 82% of width and 84% of height usable as blank writing area. The right paper edge will sit almost flush with the right edge of the game screen, so use a narrow right margin. A thin horizontal ruled divider near the top at 12% height may separate a future log title. No title or writing is painted into the asset.
NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO calligraphy, NO symbols, NO stars, NO zodiac or astrolabe, NO cloth, NO flag, NO string hanger, NO huge ornamental crest, NO scene/background, NO hands. Low-brightness weathered brass, neutral gray-brown paper and black leather, restrained old-world gothic realism compatible with forest, ruins, cosmic and bone game backgrounds. Transparent cutout, crisp detailed physical materials, no vignette fading away at the bottom.
control:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the referenced circular pause button asset. Create a single reusable EMPTY circular control button base.
Keep the realistic worn low-brightness brass outer circular ring, evenly proportioned concentric rim, four little square rivets, and dark desaturated charcoal/teal subtly textured interior. Remove the two pause bars completely and reconstruct the uninterrupted matching dark interior surface behind them. The center must be blank; no icon, letter, number or symbol. No astrology or radial guide lines. The rim must be a true circle centered exactly in a square image, identical width and height, no perspective or tilt, only 2% transparent padding outside its maximum circular diameter. Use actual transparent background, not a painted black or checkerboard background. Muted material highlights, no glow. Deliver only this one blank round control base, suitable for reusing under pause and gear icons at exactly the same size.
